Name: Tools Improvement
Author: MGLXI
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Tools Improvement[/b][/size][/center]
[b]Tools Improvement[/b] is a visual replacement mod for Stardew Valley focused on [b]tool progression[/b]. The goal isn’t just to swap sprites — it’s to make every upgrade feel like an actual upgrade. Each tier evolves visually: more detail, better finish, and a distinct identity for every material.
This is not a simple repaint of the vanilla assets. Every tool was designed so the player can feel the jump in quality when going from basic → copper → steel → gold → iridium (and for the scythe: normal → golden → iridium).
[line]
[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[]29 custom sprites for selected tools and items.[]Visual progression per tier: each upgrade has a distinct, more detailed design.[]Clean replacement via Content Patcher, without overwriting game files.[]Individual configuration: enable or disable each tool replacement from the Content Patcher config menu (Generic Mod Config Menu recommended).[*]Compatible with existing saves: it’s purely a visual change.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b]🛠️ Included tools[/b][/size]
[list]
[]Hoe: basic, copper, steel, gold, iridium.[]Pickaxe: basic, copper, steel, gold, iridium.[]Axe: basic, copper, steel, gold, iridium.[]Watering Can: basic, copper, steel, gold, iridium.[]Scythe: normal, golden, iridium.[]Fishing rods: Training Rod, Bamboo Pole, Fiberglass Rod, Iridium Rod, Advanced Iridium Rod.[*][b]Return Scepter[/b].[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[]Stardew Valley 1.6+[]SMAPI[*][b]Content Patcher[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[]Install SMAPI.[]Install Content Patcher.[]Download and unzip Upgrade Tools into Stardew Valley/Mods/.[]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/list][line]
[size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/size]
The mod includes options to enable or disable each tool replacement individually. You can edit them from:
[list]
[]Generic Mod Config Menu (recommended), or[]the config.json file that Content Patcher generates automatically.[/list]By default, all tools are enabled.
[line]
[size=5][b]🔧 Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[]Compatible with new and existing saves.[]Does not replace original game files: it uses Content Patcher image patches.[*]Can coexist with other replacement mods as long as they don’t edit the exact same coordinates in [font=Courier New]TileSheets/tools[/font] or [font=Courier New]TileSheets/weapons[/font]. If you use another tool mod, check load order or disable conflicting options.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b]🐛 Reporting issues[/b][/size]
If you find a misaligned sprite, a missing file, or a visual conflict, please report it with:
[list]
[]mod version,[]Stardew Valley version,[]SMAPI and Content Patcher versions,[]screenshot if possible.[/list][line]
[size=5][b]❤️ Credits[/b][/size]
Created by [b][MGLXI][/b]. Sprites and concept: [b]Upgrade Tools[/b]. Thanks to Pathoschild for Content Patcher and to the Stardew Valley modding community.
